title: Simón Bolívar's birth chart
metaDescription: Simón Bolívar's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 1.5° Leo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 1.5° Leo, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At noon on that date the Sun stood at 1.5° Leo, inside the first decan (0°–10°), whose traditional sub-ruler is the Sun. The decan is the older, finer division — it is what the sign looks like once you stop rounding it to thirty degrees.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 11.9° Cancer; Venus stands at 16.3° Virgo; Mars stands at 6.8° Aries. The tradition reads thought steeped in tone and memory from Mercury, attraction that grows by reliability from Venus, effort spent in bursts and openings from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Saturn to Neptune is the closest call of the day, a square within 0.2°. The old texts treat a square as the aspect you feel earliest and thank latest: obstruction first, competence afterwards. Behind it, Mars square Saturn at 0.8°, and Mars opposition Neptune at 1.0° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: Mercury opposes Saturn while both square Mars. A t-square aims the whole axis at its apex planet; the tradition reads it as the chart’s standing assignment. Venus makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags five placements in this chart. The Sun in Leo at 1.5° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Venus in Virgo at 16.3° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mars in Aries at 6.8° is in domicile; Jupiter in Capricorn at 27.0° is in fall; Saturn in Capricorn at 7.6° is in domicile. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements air 3, earth 3, fire 2, water 2; modalities cardinal 6, fixed 2, mutable 2. Jupiter, Saturn and Pluto were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Gemini for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 11.9° between midnight and midnight. The missing clock moves the Moon by half a sign at most here, and the boundary was never close. At the noon reference it stands at 10.7°.
